highlights.title: I Think I Found an AI Agent Worth the Risk
highlights.summary: Instinct saved me $550, booked my restaurant reservations, and warned me about a phishing scam. It also wasted $64 and might be a security nightmare.
body: One of the first things I did when I left my full-time job at WIRED was give Claude Cowork access to my email and calendar. After reporting on artificial intelligence for years, I was curious about what the technology could do for me. I had imagined Cowork as a hyper-capable digital assistant, but was let down to discover that it was more like interacting with a regular chatbot, albeit one with extra tools. What did I want it to do? I had no idea.

Then Instinct, an invite-only AI agent that communicates with users through iMessage and WhatsApp, started popping off in the Bay Area. It connects to your email, calendar, and messaging apps. Think of it as OpenClaw for normies. The company, which launched in private beta in February, is reportedly in talks to raise $1 billion on top of the $350 million it’s already raised, bringing its valuation to $10 billion, according to The Information.

highlights.title: Warwickshire close in on County Championship title after skittling Leicestershire
highlights.summary: Warwickshire took a big step towards clinching the Rothesay County Championship title after skittling relegation-threatened Leicestershire for 125 at Edgbaston.
body: Ahead of the first day's play, Leicestershire announced plans to appeal their 27-point deduction for a substandard pitch at Grace Road in last month's win over Glamorgan - a decision that means their Division One fate could remain up in the air until the final round of fixtures this week.
Only two of their batters passed 12 in Birmingham, with in-form Ethan Bamber taking 4-42 and former England seamer Chris Woakes claiming 3-20 for the Bears, who closed on 130-4 to lead by five.

A Warwickshire win would guarantee a first title since the Covid-shortened 2021 campaign, with second-placed Somerset struggling against Surrey, who closed on 327-4 thanks to an unbeaten 104 from England's Dan Lawrence.
Nottinghamshire captain Haseeb Hameed's 71 underpinned his side's 242-9 against Yorkshire at Trent Bridge.

highlights.title: Google’s Gemini Can Now Make Calls for You on Pixel Phones
highlights.summary: Call for Me—a feature that’s exclusive to the Pixel 11 series—gives robocalls a new meaning.
body: Google has been trying to have its AI assistant make phone calls on your behalf for almost 10 years. Remember Duplex? It enabled the now-defunct Google Assistant to call restaurants and book tables. That service was shuttered a few years ago, but now comes round two, powered by modern large language models.

On Thursday, Google announced Call for Me, an experimental beta feature exclusive to its latest Pixel 11 smartphones in the US (and in English). Pixel 11 owners need a Gemini subscription and have to be enrolled in the Phone by Google app’s public beta. Google has instructions on how to participate here.

These calls are designed to reach businesses. Gemini can call your local hardware store to ask if they stock a specific tool, or chat with a barber to schedule a haircut. Just tell Gemini to make the call—it may ask you follow-up questions for more context—and the chatbot will introduce itself and can have a back-and-forth conversation to ensure your request is handled. If it runs into an automated phone menu, it can navigate it and even wait on hold. On your end, you can view a live transcript on the Pixel and take over at any point.
points: Call for Me—a feature that’s exclusive to the Pixel 11 series—gives robocalls a new meaning.

highlights.summary: Robert Pattinson has trouble imagining a universe where his Batman and James Gunn's Superman could co-exist, casting doubt on a potential crossover. Speaking with LADbible, Pattinson stated that he thinks it would be difficult to pluck his take on a dark, grounded Batman and drop him in James…
body: “I think it would be kind of tough to have this version of Bruce outside of that world," he said. "It's one of the only characters, I guess because of the length of the shoots, but also it's such a specific kind of [style], the tone of it gets inside you. I remember that happened to me the last time I did it, it took a while. You’re just in the dark, the whole time. Both mood-wise and light-wise, I can't see anything for like months. It does affect you, like you feel strange afterwards."

Fans have been somewhat split for a while now over whether Pattinson should also play Batman in Gunn's main DC universe, or if he should remain relegated to his own separate part of the multiverse, and it seems like Pattinson believes the latter makes the most sense. James Gunn himself has said that they're developing a Batman film that will follow an older Bruce Wayne, with Damian Wayne as his sidekick.

body: This means Mo.co will run “on low maintenance,” says Supercell, and no further weapons or premium tracks will be released. Elite merch and content “will be recycled from previous seasons.”

“Our goal is to release updates more frequently and reduce the wait between them,” the team explained, adding there was no date planned for the next update, but it expected to roll one out before the end of 2026.

body: “We were immediately bonded,” he added. “It was a shared excitement about being invited to make a film like this. Marvel Studios had made one film at that time, which was ‘Iron Man,’ which we both loved, and we were being directed by Kenneth Branagh, Anthony Hopkins was playing our father, Rene Russo was playing our mother, and we had extraordinary resources. We had an amazing, brilliant creative stunt department where we would train for sequences of dizzying choreography. We both loved movement and these opportunities.”

Of the project’s scale, Hiddleston said, “It was a different dimension.” “The scenes themselves were very deep. They were full of turbulence, turmoil, soul and emotion The material was really deep, so the combination of those things was a thrill.”

The Brit thanked late screenwriter Don Payne for developing Loki’s “complex” backstory, and recalled an early conversation with Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige, who told him “Thor” wasn’t “the only film you’re going to be in.”

highlights.title: Trump touts ‘great meeting’ with China’s Xi Jinping at White House – live
highlights.summary: Xi Jinping says China and US must ensure AI ‘is always under human control’ and backs US-Iran deal to end war and reopen strait of Hormuz. At Trump meeting, Xi lays out terms to avoid US-China military conflict.
body: Here is brief recap of the remarks made by Donald Trump and Xi Jinping just now on the Chinese president’s landmark state visit to Washington.

Trump touted their “truly great friendship” and that they had made “tremendous strides on the issues facing our countries” as he welcomed Xi to the White House. He kept his remarks vague and focused on their personal relationship, of which he said he is “very proud”. Trump said the two leaders would focus on security, technology and artificial intelligence at their summit today, and are working towards “a more balanced trade relationship”.

Xi, meanwhile, struck a very different tone, acknowledging that he and Trump have built a “personal rapport” but concentrating his remarks on geopolitical concerns. Xi called for continued dialogue and the building of mutual trust, understanding and peaceful co-existence between the two countries and to avoid conflict. He stressed that Chinese and US interests are “deeply intertwined” and that they “stand to gain from co-operation and will both lose in conflict”. He also stated clearly his hope that Chinese companies would be “treated fairly” in the United States.
points: Xi Jinping says China and US must ensure AI ‘is always under human control’ and backs US-Iran deal to end war and reopen strait of Hormuz.

highlights.title: Why can’t we just keep rogue AIs off the internet?
highlights.summary: AI agents keep getting loose, escaping supposedly secure tests to attack real-world targets, commandeer obscure wikis, and leave instructions for other agents to follow. Researchers are testing these systems precisely because they might behave in unpredictable, even dangerous, ways.
body: Air-gapping AI to keep it away from real-world targets makes testing safer, but less useful.
“A strict air gap reduces realism... [It’s a] trade-off, not a fundamental technical issue.”

In theory, yes. Researchers can isolate the computers running AI tools from the internet and other outside networks, a technique known as air gapping. That can mean physically removing or disabling cables and wireless hardware and using “dumb” peripherals, with particularly sensitive setups using Faraday cages or other shielding to block electromagnetic signals from getting in or out. Done properly, an air-gapped system would offer agents no straightforward route to external targets, or outside systems any straightforward route in, making it much harder, if not impossible, to pull off attacks like the one OpenAI’s models launched against Hugging Face.

highlights.title: All Xbox rumors, changes, and cancelled games in 2026 (so far)
highlights.summary: The last several months have been a roller coaster for Xbox. On Sept. 22, chief content officer Matt Booty disclosed 268 more layoffs, as well as the consolidation of smaller studios like Obsidian and Rare into larger ones, namely Bethesda and Activision.
body: It may take weeks or even months until we get an exact picture of all the changes taking place at Xbox, but here's what we know. The stories below are presented in reverse chronological order, so the newest developments will appear at the top.

In an internal memo following news of the Sept. 22 changes, Bethesda Game Studios head Jill Braff said, "Today’s announcement is primarily a change in reporting structure. The creative identity and strengths that make Obsidian distinct will remain at the core of their studio and work."

While Obsidian seems likely to survive and not be transformed into a support studio for Bethesda, it probably won't enjoy the same freedom to experiment that it has enjoyed in years past. Elsewhere in the memo, Braff foregrounded the two studios' collaboration on an upcoming Fallout project, noting that "this structure supports the franchise-led model we’ve been strengthening while keeping accountability for both the studio and the franchise clear."

highlights.title: Susan Sarandon, Hannah Einbinder Detained at United Nations Netanyahu Protest
highlights.summary: Fellow actor Caleb Hearon was also among the nearly 100 demonstrators taken into custody ahead of the Israeli leader addressing the United Nations General Assembly in New York City.
body: Susan Sarandon, Hannah Einbinder and Caleb Hearon on Thursday were reportedly among around 100 protesters taken into custody on Thursday in New York City ahead of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addressing the United Nations General Assembly.
Sarandon was detained, according to a number of outlets, including The New York Times, with photographers snapping images of the Oscar winner waiting to be transported from the protest.

And the U.S. edition of The Sun tabloid, while including footage of Sarandon being taken into custody, also posted photos of Hearon and Einbinder being arrested near the UN headquarters. Einbinder recently defended fellow actor Mark Ruffalo against an accusation of “antisemitism” from Paramount Skydance over his opposition to the studio’s deal for Warner Bros. Discovery.

Representatives for Sarandon, Einbinder and Hearon could not be reached for comment on Thursday, and the New York Police Department also could not be contacted via its media phone line. Reports indicate the celebrities and politicians were detained by the NYPD for blocking traffic and roadways along First Avenue near 39th Street, just a few blocks south of the UN headquarters.

highlights.title: F-Droid gets its biggest update in a decade with new UI and smoother app installs
highlights.summary: Virtually every Android device comes with the Play Store preloaded, but there are other ways to get apps. F-Droid bills itself as a community-driven source for free and open source Android apps, but its official app store has gone 10 years without a major update.
body: The new F-Droid client was redesigned from scratch in Kotlin Compose, which is the standard for modern Android apps. This makes the store much more responsive, and there’s optional support for Android’s Material theming. The interface has also been cleaned up considerably, making the most important functions easier to access and hiding some others in overflow menus.

While the new F-Droid looks nicer, the update was largely about making it easier to find and install apps. When F-Droid first appeared, there wasn’t much to see, but now it has thousands of open source apps. Unlike the Play Store, F-Droid doesn’t track your taps and installs to push ads and suggestions—it helps you find things and gets out of the way.

F-Droid now includes a huge number of categories, drilling down to specialized niches like firewalls, password managers, and VPNs. You can see all these groups in the search tab. There are also higher-level categories listed on the main Discover page. When searching for apps, F-Droid will now be able to return results based on app descriptions rather than just names.

body: Sky News can reveal that English football's top flight and the top domestic leagues in Germany, Italy and Spain will publish a collective statement demanding greater consultation on key issues such as the global football calendar.

The statement was still in the process of being formally agreed between the quartet of domestic leagues on Thursday afternoon and it was unclear whether it would specifically call for Infantino to stand down.

highlights.title: Spider-Man's Jacob Batalon Explains What Destin Daniel Cretton Likes Most About Naruto and Why Team 7 Could Be the Movie's Focus
highlights.summary: Jacob Batalon shed some light on what Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton likes most about Naruto, giving fans a tentative idea of the direction his live-action adaptation of the iconic anime series might take.
body: Jacob Batalon, who plays Peter Parker’s bestie Ned Leeds in the Tom Holland films, sat down for an episode of The Anime Effect podcast with Crunchyroll on September 19 to chat about all things anime.
Naturally, the topic of Destin Daniel Cretton’s live-action Naruto movie came up, prompting the hosts to quiz him about what the Brand New Day director likes best about the classic anime.

Speaking from his own perspective, Batalon said that he feels like Cretton is drawn to the origin story of Team 7 — the main group of characters in the original Naruto series, initially made up of Naruto, Sasuke, Sakura, and its leader, Kakashi.

“I think he likes the aspect of Team 7 and their coming-up story,” he explained. “I think that’s really cool. I think for a lot of storytelling in movies, when you’re trying to move from a specific IP to movies meant for everyone, you have to start somewhere where everyone kind of understands where they’re coming from. I think a lot of origin story-type things are really important when you’re trying to tell a story that not everyone is accustomed to.

highlights.title: Buttler injury halts England as Sri Lanka level series
highlights.summary: Jos Buttler's bravery comes in vain as Sri Lanka fight back to beat England in the second one-day international at Headingley and set up a series decider at The Oval.
body: Needing 68 from 75 balls, England were cruising towards a target of 322 until Buttler retired hurt on 67 after tweaking a hamstring.
When Rehan Ahmed, Gus Atkinson and Jamie Overton fell, Buttler re-emerged with 27 now needed from 14 balls and witnessed Will Jacks fall for 52 at the non-striker's end.
England were left needing 19 from the last with Buttler on strike but, barely able to hobble a single, he holed out at deep mid-wicket. England finished on 306-9 as Sri Lanka won by 16 runs.

Buttler had earlier shown flashes of his vintage best in hitting Sri Lanka's spinners for five sixes, putting England on course after collapse of 3-14 spoiled an opening stand of 143 between Tom Banton and Ben Duckett.

body: Polymarket is “sidestepping its obligation to pay taxes like licensed casinos and mobile sports gambling platforms do,” New York said. “This tax revenue from gambling regulation funds public schools, sports programs for underserved youth, and problem gambling education and treatment.”

Polymarket is “available to users between the ages of 18–20, even though New York law requires a person to be at least 21 years old to participate in mobile sports betting,” exposing young people to gambling’s “damaging effects on their mental and financial well-being,” New York said.

New York previously sued Kalshi, Polymarket’s chief rival. The Trump administration is on the side of the prediction markets, with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) asserting exclusive jurisdiction over the platforms. In August, the CFTC declared a “market emergency” in New York in an attempt to stop the state from applying its gambling laws to Kalshi.
Polymarket and its rival Kalshi offer sports bets in the form of “event contracts” or “swaps,” which state governments and some courts say are just gambling with a different name.

highlights.summary: New York-based indie distributor Dekanalog has acquired the U.S. rights to “Nina Roza,” Canada’s Academy Awards submission. Geneviève Dulude-De Celles’ film won the Silver Bear for best screenplay at the Berlin Film Festival this year.
body: Dekanalog will release “Nina Roza” theatrically in early 2027, followed by VOD and Blu-ray debuts. The company has also acquired the U.S. rights to Dulude-De Celles’ 2018 feature, “A Colony,” and plans to also release next year.

“ ‘Nina Roza’ brilliantly explores the subtle, but profound ways immigration affects a person’s identity — something all too rarely depicted on screen,” says Sam Wunderl, partner at Dekanalog. “We are incredibly proud to be bringing Dulude-De Celles’s work to a U.S. audience.”

Dulude-De Celles said, “I am thrilled that ‘Nina Roza’ has the opportunity to be presented in the United States. By following the journey of a Canadian of Bulgarian origin who returns to his home country, the film invites us to look with empathy at those who choose to settle far from their homeland. I hope the film will spark discussions about identity, heritage, and the long-term cost of immigration. Our team feels in good hands with Dekanalog and is excited about the next steps in our collaboration.”

highlights.title: Bob Mackie obituary
highlights.summary: American fashion designer and costumier who clothed glamorous showbiz celebrities, especially Cher. Most costume designers are novelists, supplying character, back stories, social placement and history, done in cloth.
body: Mackie, who has died aged 87, was master of the showbiz sartorial aesthetic that evolved on stage and in films to entertain in itself as well as project performers.

Rhinestones, sequins, beads, plaques, plumes, plush, le tout ensemble. An audience got a big kick from a Mackie costume before a word was spoken or a note was sung, and performers had total confidence in him, as he studied their bodies, movements and personality before designing.
He did that with divas from Judy Garland through Diana Ross, Barbra Streisand, Bette Midler, Whitney Houston, Madonna and, especially, Cher.

Theirs was an interactive relationship from Cher’s television appearances in the 70s, when he guided her out of hippiedom and into minimal material spectacularly styled. He and she plotted the crest of black feathers she wore to the 1986 Academy Awards, atop an outfit that linked back to the extreme exoticism of early movie stars such as Gloria Swanson. What little there was of it was perfectly executed; Mackie costumes were made to couture standards – even his reworkings of second-hand gowns for a broke Tina Turner.

Most costume designers are novelists, supplying character, back stories, social placement and history, done in cloth.

highlights.title: Where to find bitter leaves in Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave
highlights.summary: As you look for bitter leaves in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, you will find yourself traveling to the four corners of the game's map. Even though this is not a rare material, there are only a few locations where you can find it.
body: Here's a list with all the nodes where you can find bitter leaves in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave.

There are four nodes in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave from which you can collect bitter leaves. Most of them are considerably far from Dagsion, so make sure you have enough turns to reach the node before any deadlines.

One of the closest nodes to the early areas in the game is Traveler's Garden. You will find it in the northeast corner of the map, in the Castalia region. Although it takes a while to get there if you haven't unlocked the Eochaid Posthouse, once you do, visiting the node and collecting some bitter leaves will take only a few turns.

On the other side of the map, in the Solidus region, you will find the Cape Nereus node. By searching this one, you can find not only bitter leaves, but also pepper leaves. The quickest way to reach this node, if you have already explored the region, is by using a carriage to Aragona Posthouse.

highlights.summary: You are not the only one, advice columnist Eleanor Gordon-Smith writes. It will help to ask whether you have a time problem or a bandwidth problem. I love my life in so many ways.
body: I love my life in so many ways. I have a rewarding job, I’m making stellar progress towards a graduate degree, I have incredible friends and community, plus I’m even reconnecting with estranged family. My cup is very full but I still feel grief and shame for how much falls to the wayside.

I have missed countless doctors’ appointments. My vehicle’s license plates have been expired for almost a year. I often apologise to angry friends and acquaintances after they confront me for not seeing them in months. My significant other says she doesn’t see me enough. So do my parents. I clock out of work and shudder at the thought of facing my growing avalanche of text messages. I panic whenever I receive an email that demands I arrange yet another appointment or submit to a lengthy phone call. The stack of forms I’m overdue to submit makes me feel so irresponsible, as if I’m the only adult alive who can’t seem to take care of business.
